notes.title: Announcing the KeyWe Challenge Update!
notes.content:
Hey Teleposters, we’re excited to announce a new KeyWe update, just in time for Hollyjostle! 

This is a free patch for all PC players, and it’s available now. The update includes:

Challenges!
Some levels now offer optional Challenge objectives - just look for the Challenge Coin icon in the Calendar or Overtime Shift board. 

Can you win the Snowball Fight without letting a single cassowary throw a snowball? How about popping every red bubble in the Bubble Wrap Testing room? Some of these are meant to be pretty tough, even for seasoned Teleposters, and we can’t wait to see your kiwi tactics in action. We believe in you (and Jeff and Debra)!

Aside from an immense feeling of accomplishment, beating Challenges will also bag you some…

New kiwi customizations!
Completing Challenges will earn you Challenge Coins, which you can spend on newly-added stuff in the Wardrobe. Bungalow Basin’s winter Hollyjostle celebration is in full swing, so we’ve added a flurry of festive items like Reindeer Antlers, fuzzy Winter Boots, and the incredible Walrus Tusks facewear. We think that last one is really gonna knock your socks off.

This patch will also add some Wardrobe items that you can get with regular ol’ Stamps, like the Elfen Winklepicker shoes (they jingle when you run!) and the Peppermint Plumage skin (which looks extremely fresh). 

We don’t want to spoil everything here, though. The best thing you can do is download and play it yourselves! Let us know what you think in the comments or over on Twitter. 

Thanks for playing KeyWe. Your postal antics and support are a constant source of joy and inspiration for our team. From everybirdy here at Stonewheat & Sons and Fireshine Games, have a very Happy Hollyjostle!

notes.title: 100th Annual Grand Ol’ Telepost Tournament DLC!
notes.content:
From guiding ghostly mail during Wickertide to delivering letters to Papa Moon during Hollyjostle, traditions are a pillar of Bungalow Basin! But there’s one Bungalow-Basin tradition you might not have heard of, and we’ve been dying to tell you about it. It’s the Annual Telepost Tournament!

[previewyoutube=R5SX_l0JEEU;full][/previewyoutube]

The 100th Annual Grand Ol’ Telepost Tournament

The Annual Telepost Tournament is an exciting racing challenge where postal pros from all over Bungalow Basin gather to test their skills and compete for the title of Postmaster! Jeff and Debra have been working hard all year and now they’re ready to represent Relay Station 4 in this new KeyWe downloadable content! Available right now, here! If you haven’t played KeyWe yet, you’ll even be able to take advantage of a 33% discount on the full version of the game for the next 48hrs.

Introducing a Brand-New Game Mode

The Grand Ol’ Telepost Tournament DLC combines all the best parts of an obstacle course with some of the challenges of an athletic decathlon to test postal workers’ cooperation skills, quick thinking, speed, and their ability to keep calm under pressure! You’ll be going head-to-head with staff members from other relay stations to prove you have what it takes to deliver mail across any terrain in courses themed after Bungalow Basin locales!

Trek through the lush pastures of Gumtree Grove, brave the harsh deserts of Painted Cliffs, and paddle through the winding waterways of Lake Bessy! The tournament will see Jeff and Debra climbing across treacherous cliffs, delving into dark diamond mines, feeding hungry crocodiles, and much more. You can even take on additional objectives throughout the levels and conquer them to earn extra rewards. Oh, and speaking of rewards…

All-New Wardrobe Items (and a New Friend?!)

It’s not easy being the best-dressed birds in Bungalow Basin, but someone's gotta do it! The Tournament rewards some very flashy new items for your Wardrobe. Sail Lake Bessy in a ferocious pirate hat, lace up a stylin' set of kiwi running shoes, or lend an extra hand at the Telepost with kiwi-sized arms! Yes, ARMS. You'll also meet a very special kiwi named Herbert. He’s a little different from Jeff and Debra, but we love him all the same!

We hope you have tons of fun playing through these new level designs and that the 100th Grand Ol’ Telepost Tournament brings a whole new level of mailroom mayhem to your KeyWe experiences! We can’t wait to hear what you think and see Jeff and Debra dressed up in even more adorable outfits. Join the discussion and share your screenshots over on the official KeyWe Twitter page or in the KeyWe Discord Server!

notes.title: KeyWe Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Hey there Teleposters, we hope you’re having a great time tackling the Telepost so far. We wanted to say a BIG thank you for all of your support over on the official KeyWe Twitter and Discord channels – we love seeing your wardrobe choices and hearing about your favourite characters and levels. 

Whilst kiwis are omnivores and their diet primarily consists of insects, they can’t be expected to run the Telepost and take care of any bugs they spot along the way. Don’t worry, though, that’s where your handy KeyWe development team comes in! Read on for the latest KeyWe patch notes…


Level Fixes

Telegraph Desk Levels
You reported some synchronisation issues with the Telegraph Desk levels. We’ve submitted some safety nets to try and catch these issues!

Transcription Room Levels
We’ve implemented a fix so that the post toaster is a little more forgiving in terms of timing – there’s no such thing as perfect timing, after all! We also fixed an issue with the buckles on the Cassowary bags in the winter levels – we guess the cold weather was making them difficult to fasten!

Electrical Interference 
After completing a goal with the "overcharged" mechanic (where your kiwis glow blue and red), the game would not let you progress. We’re pleased to report that this bug has well and truly been zapped!

Bitter Cold
Some of our winter weather mechanics (namely the ice blocks and conveyor belts) weren’t functioning properly in online games. We’ve since fixed this frosty little bug AND we’ve increased the lantern radius to make melting the ice a little bit easier, but we are aware of some other issues with this level that we'll be looking to patch at a later date. If you encounter any problems in the meantime, the best course of action is to return to the main menu and relaunch the level from the calendar.

Lunch Break
We’ve patched in a fix for a known issue where your kiwis can get stuck falling forever (spooky!), but please let us know if you’re still encountering this issue.

An Approaching Storm
This level wasn’t displaying messages properly when the timer was turned off. This has been repaired, and you can now take this level at your own pace again.

Postal Pest Problems
Those pesky mailflies were blocking the crane controls and giving the kiwis a real hard time! We’ve given them a stern talking to, so this shouldn’t be an issue anymore.

Wearables & Collectibles

Lilac Breasted Roller Skin
We know this skin was displaying some rather funky colours. While cool to look at, this has been restored to its former glory.

Z39 Soaring Auk
We’ve fixed this collectible puzzle.

Controller Assignment Functionality

A new feature has been added that allows players to assign controllers and choose their keyboard layout! 


 Players can now choose who uses what controller.
 Players can choose if player 2 uses the numpad or other keys on the keyboard (if you don’t have a numpad).
 If you’re using a single controller, the other player can now use the full keyboard layout.


Localisation

 We put in a fix for an issue where players in Turkey couldn’t play online and have tested this as best as we can without flying to Turkey and testing there!
 There was also an issue where players who had Windows set to Turkish weren’t able to see certain text characters in the game. This has been repaired!
 Russian text no longer clips through the ramps in Dropoff Depot levels.
 Fixed broken Spanish messages in Transcription Room levels.
 Fixed broken Italian messages in Transcription Room levels.
 Fixed issues where certain words wouldn’t appear in the winter Telegraph Desk levels when playing in non-English languages.


Other Fixes

 Improved collision across multiple levels.
 Fixed issue with swapping kiwi customizations when playing online.
 Fixed issue in the Wardrobe with kiwi customizations being swapped after new item reveal.
 Fixed issue where personal best times show up in match results after failing a level.
 Put in catch-all to unlock progress wearables and award achievements that were earned on Demo accounts.
 Fixed Summer Postmaster and Fall Postmaster achievements. 

We hope these fixes make your KeyWe experience even more enjoyable! If you encounter anything in KeyWe that you think we need to be aware of, please feel free to email customerservice@soldout.uk.com.

notes.title: Let’s Talk About World Nature Conservation Day
notes.content:
Happy World Nature Conservation Day! You probably guessed by now, but we here at Stonewheat & Sons are big animal lovers, and we’re delighted to showcase KeyWe in the World Nature Conservation Day sale on Steam. 

The World Nature Conservation Sale

The World Nature Conservation Sale features a selection of animal and nature themed games, all of which can be purchased at a discounted price. As most of you know, KeyWe isn’t out until August 31st, so we can’t be a part of this year’s sale, but we were lucky enough to be to feature in the sale’s upcoming games section where our demo will be available to play until the 2nd of August.

What is World Nature Conservation Day?

While Bungalow Basin may be a fictional location, the animals you’ll spot working in the Telepost Office are very real, and their populations are declining rapidly due to loss of habitat.

Conservation is the care and preservation of natural resources like air, soil, and water, and safeguarding these resources can help protect animal and plant life. Conservation is achieved through the sustainable use of nature by humans and this practise needs encouraging across the globe. 

World Nature Conservation Day is celebrated on July 28th every year to raise awareness of the importance of maintaining a healthy natural environment. Climate change, pollution, deforestation, and excessive infrastructure are all dangers to our environment and can have an extremely negative impact on wildlife. 

How Can I Help Kiwi Conservation?

There are plenty of charities out there dedicated to kiwi conservation, but Kiwis for Kiwi has a special place in our hearts. Kiwis for kiwi is a New Zealand charity that supports community-led and Māori-led kiwi conservation projects. There are plenty of ways you can get involved, including volunteering and fundraising, so make sure you check out their Take Action page.

notes.title: Celebrate PAX & EGX Online with some KeyWe Gameplay!
notes.content:
Hey there, Teleposters. It’s been a bit of a funny year for making plans and, under normal circumstances, we’d have given you plenty of opportunities to enjoy KeyWe at events all over. Don’t worry though, some of your favourite events have gone virtual for the time being, and we’re still giving you the chance to experience KeyWe as part of PAX and EGX Rezzed online this year!

Experience the Mailroom Mayhem

We’re just over six weeks away from KeyWe’s official launch date, but we know you’re all itching to tackle the Telepost. So, we’re bringing the KeyWe demo back to Steam one last time for the duration of PAX and EGX Rezzed online. The KeyWe demo will be available to download from the 15th to the 18th of July and will feature two main levels plus one bonus overtime shift for you to enjoy. Playable in both single player and online co-op, you’re sure to love exploring the Shipping Floor, typing up messages at the Telegraph Desk and feeding those hungry cassowaries. 

Oh, and if you’re looking for someone to play co-op with, why join our Discord and meet the KeyWe community? 

Getting Started:

You’ll be taken through a quick demo tutorial on the game before you can play in either single-player or online co-op mode.

IMPORTANT: There is no way to connect to online co-op until after you’ve completed the demo tutorial. If you are going to be playing online co-op, we recommend just completing the tutorial in single-player mode to save time.

Online Co-Op:

To connect with another player in online co-op mode, please complete the tutorial, wait for the main menu to load, then follow these steps.

1.	Select “Online” in the main KeyWe menu.
2.	One player will need to host the game by selecting “Create Room”.
3.	The other player will need to enter the room key using their keyboard.
4.	You will get a notification in the bottom right-hand corner of the screen telling you what the other player is doing once they’re in the room.
5.	Select back to return to the main menu.
6.	Select “Play” and choose a level, which will start for both of you.

Troubleshooting:

Players who have played previous KeyWe demos may need to delete old data from their PC as this may negatively interact with the newest KeyWe build. To delete your save data…

1.	If KeyWe is running, close the application.
2.	Open your PC’s file explorer and navigate to your C drive (this is usually under “This PC” or “My PC).
3.	Open the C drive and click on the “Users” folder.
4.	Open the folder labelled with your username.
5.	Open the “AppData” folder.
6.	Open the “LocalLow” folder.
7.	Open the “Stonewheat_Sons” folder and delete all the files and folders located here.
8.	Re-launch the KeyWe application and play as usual.

We hope you enjoy the KeyWe demo, and we hope you're as excited for the full version of the game to launch as we are! Remember, you can show your support for KeyWe by wishlisting on Steam. And make sure you're following us on Twitter for even more KeyWe content.

notes.title: KeyWe Launches on PC and Console August 31st 2021!
notes.content:
Get ready for mailroom mayhem, KeyWe is launching for PC and console on August 31st 2021!

[previewyoutube=SXHp1O1R2F8;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey Teleposters, it’s Joel from the KeyWe development team here. I’m so happy to announce our official release date and can’t wait for you to play KeyWe. We’ll be putting the finishing touches on the game over the next three months to make sure we achieve the perfect balance of cute and chaotic...and cassowaries!

If you’re brand new to KeyWe, let me tell you what you can expect when you play. If you’re familiar with the game, scroll on down for our Early Bird Pack announcement.

The Mail Must Flow!
You play as Jeff and Debra, two determined little kiwi birds who work at the Bungalow Basin Telepost Office. Both kiwis will need to work together to type telegrams, transcribe urgent messages, assemble shipping crates and get the mail sent to the residents of Bungalow Basin on time.

Watch Out for Workplace Hazards!
Bungalow Basin is a rugged place, and Jeff and Debra will need to brave plenty of precarious postal predicaments - from sandstorms, floods and blizzards to carnivorous plants and paranormal activity. All in a day’s work at the Telepost.

Collect Stamps to Customise Your Kiwis!
Earn stamps at the end of each shift and use them to unlock wardrobe items and become the best-dressed birds in Bungalow Basin. We can’t wait for you to see all the ways you can outfit Jeff and Debra for the job.

Enjoy Extra Action with Overtime Shifts!
Take a break from your daily duties and help out on bonus overtime shifts. Feeding hungry cassowaries, testing the Telepost’s bubble-wrap supply, snowball fights with your animal co-workers – these fast-paced mini-games are a great way to earn some extra stamps!

Get Our Exclusive Early Bird Pack!
Make sure you wishlist KeyWe on Steam now so you don’t miss out on our FREE Early Bird Pack, only available for Steam users who download KeyWe during launch week. The Early Bird Pack comes with a whole bunch of Telepost-themed wardrobe items – Jeff and Debra love representing their workplace and looking fly (get it?) while they’re at it. Oh, but watch out for that Experimental Postal Pack, rumour has it that it can upset the fabric of space-time. The Early Bird Pack is available for a limited time only.

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E2ZeEdXXIAELVUS?format=jpg&name=4096x4096

Finally, I wanted to extend a big thank you to the KeyWe community from all of us here at Stonewheat & Sons and Sold Out. We wouldn’t be where we are today without you, your amazing feedback and your positivity on our Twitter, Instagram and Discord channels. I hope you have just as much fun playing KeyWe as we did making it and can’t wait to hear what you think! <3

notes.title: Competition: Get Your Message in the Game & Become Part of KeyWe History!
notes.content:
Calling all Teleposters, we want YOU to be a part of KeyWe history. We’re giving you the chance to get your name and a personalised message for a friend to appear in KeyWe with our brand-new competition!

How to Enter:

Entries must be submitted via Twitter. Imagine you’re sending a pizza to a friend through the post (strange, we know!), then like and re-Tweet the post at the URL below and comment underneath with the message you’d send along with your pizza. Don’t forget to start your message with “Dear ____”, using the blank space to tag your friend’s Twitter account.

https://twitter.com/KeyWeGame/status/1370706358031544322?s=20 

You’ve only got Twitter’s 280 character limit, so get creative! Multiple entries are allowed so long as you’re tagging different friends. Competition closes on Saturday the 20th of March 2021, and we’ll be picking our favourite the following day (Sunday the 21st). Make sure your Twitter DMs are open so that we can send you a message to let you know you’ve won!

Terms and Conditions:

These terms and conditions apply to the competition referenced above. You will be deemed to have accepted these terms and conditions and to have agreed to be bound by them upon entering the competition.

Competition entries must be submitted via the competition post on Twitter (located at: URL). If you fail to adhere to the competition’s entry mechanics (outlined above), you may be excluded from the winner selection process. This competition is open to entrants of all ages from all parts of the world. Multiple entries are allowed, provided the entrant tags in a different friend for each entry. Messages must not contain any inappropriate content and must be suitable for all audiences, as KeyWe is a family friendly game.

The competition closes at 11:59pm GMT on Saturday the 20th of March 2021, and a winner will be contacted via direct message on Twitter no later than 11:59pm GMT on Sunday the 21st of March 2021. If the winner cannot be contacted for whatever reason before 11:59pm GMT on Wednesday the 24th of March, Stonewheat & Sons and Sold Out reserve the right to select an alternative winner.
The prize constitutes the creation of one (1) personalised message to appear in one or more levels of the 2021 puzzle platform game KeyWe. The personalised message will be as close to the winning entry as feasibly possible and will include both the entrant’s name and the name of the Twitter user tagged by the entrant within their competition submission. A Sold Out representative will contact the winner from the official KeyWe Twitter account (www.twitter.com/KeyWeGame) to confirm the exact names and name formatting they would like to appear within their winning message. A Sold Out representative will never contact you regarding this competition from any other social media account or email address.

Please note that Stonewheat & Sons reserves the right to modify the winning message to align with KeyWe’s in-game mechanics and any character limitations. This may involve the addition or omission of words/phrases in conjunction with gameplay requirements (e.g. alluding to the fact that the pizza accompanying the winner’s message is “perishable” to guide players during the in-game packaging process).

If you are the winner, a Sold Out representative may ask to tag your Twitter account in social media content concerning the results of the competition. Subject to receiving your consent, you may be tagged in one or more posts on the official KeyWe Twitter channel.
The following persons are excluded from entering the competition, and their entries will not be considered:


 Employees of Stonewheat & Sons, Sold Out and any associated company.
 Any person directly or indirectly involved in the running of the competition.

notes.title: Happy Hollyjostle!
notes.content:
As the year is coming to an end, all of us at Stonewheat want to deliver a message to our awesome community!

Firstly, thank you all so much for your support throughout 2020! We're looking forward to unloading tons more content for you in 2021. We have so much to come and we can't wait to share it all with you!

We also want to wish you all a Merry Christmas, or as those in Bungalow Basin call it, Happy HollyJostle! We hope it is full of laughs, food and drink, and amazing parcels full of goodies!

Jeff and Debra are personally hoping for some new hats to wear around the post room. We'll make sure to get to work on that for them :D
